name: any-llm

providers.gemini: any_llm.completion(model=model, provider='gemini', api_base=WIRETRUTH_BASE_URL_GEMINI, api_key=WIRETRUTH_API_KEY); host-root base URL
providers.anthropic: any_llm.completion(model=model, provider='anthropic', api_base=WIRETRUTH_BASE_URL_ANTHROPIC, api_key=WIRETRUTH_API_KEY); host root, SDK appends /v1/messages and uses x-api-key

finish.primary: choices[0].finish_reason; error.completion.choices[0].finish_reason on finish-reason errors. Responses status / incomplete_details.reason; completed with function_call output means tool_calls; refusal parts mean refusal. No separate raw finish. Native Ollama: non-stream tool calls report tool_calls; streams map done_reason directly, including stop on a tool finish; unknown reasons become stop. Gemini also exposes normalized ChatCompletion finish reasons, without the native enum. Anthropic stop_reason is normalized by any-llm into choices[0].finish_reason; native stop_reason is not exposed separately.

text.primary: choices[0].message.content; streaming choices[0].delta.content; error.completion.choices[0].message.content; Responses output message output_text parts or response.output_text.delta

tool_calls.primary: choices[0].message.tool_calls; streaming choices[0].delta.tool_calls joined by index; error.completion.choices[0].message.tool_calls; Responses function_call items use call_id, name and arguments; streaming output_item.added and argument deltas joined by output_index; arguments read with json.loads. Native Ollama generates UUID ids and serializes argument objects; streaming calls have increasing indexes. Gemini creates ids when absent on the wire; truth accepts those ids.

usage.primary: usage.prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens; also error.completion.usage on finish-reason errors; Responses usage.input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, input_tokens_details.cached_tokens, output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens. Native Ollama exposes prompt/eval counts and their sum, but no cached or reasoning counts. Gemini reports candidates plus thoughts as completion_tokens and exposes thoughts separately as reasoning_tokens; streamed usage is the last snapshot. Anthropic input includes cache reads and writes in prompt_tokens; cache_read_input_tokens is exposed as prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens. Thinking is included in completion_tokens with no separate reasoning count.

structured.primary: response_format is a Pydantic model built from the input schema; choices[0].message.parsed is the parsed output; Responses output_parsed from response_format is reported only on return

stream.primary: Chat: no completion signal (the ChatCompletionChunk iterator ends the same way with or without [DONE]); last finish reason and last usage-bearing chunk. Responses: the final event (response.completed, response.incomplete or response.failed) and no error. Native Ollama also yields ChatCompletionChunk objects without a separate completion signal. Gemini uses the same iterator without an independent completion signal. Anthropic also yields normalized ChatCompletionChunk objects with final accumulated usage; no independent message_stop signal is exposed.

unsupported.reason: any-llm completion maps typed response_format to native output_config.format and has no structured parser for an explicitly forced tool.

config_notes: any-llm Responses rejects a typed response_format with stream=True; structured scenarios use the non-stream path.
Ollama tool_choice is not mapped; scenarios omit it. Native stream_options is accepted and discarded by any-llm; final usage needs no opt-in.
Native reasoning_effort none becomes think=false; other explicit efforts become low/medium/high strings. The shim passes the requested effort unchanged.
The openai provider remaps max_tokens to max_completion_tokens even with an Ollama base URL. The shim retains this library behavior.
Native Ollama needs the ollama Python package (any-llm-sdk[ollama] extra), pinned here as ollama 0.6.3.
Gemini reasoning_effort none raises in any-llm; the shim omits it and records a note, using the model default (MINIMAL for gemini-3.5-flash-lite). Other efforts pass through.

Gemini completion needs google-genai from the any-llm-sdk[gemini] extra, pinned here as 2.26.0 from the supplied library surface probe. Its completion imports do not require the extra's google-cloud-storage package. Manifest packages are installed individually; no project lock change is needed.
Anthropic 0.125.0 is pinned from the offline uv cache; any-llm-sdk 1.33.0 requires anthropic>=0.124.0,<1. Each manifest package is installed individually.

Anthropic reasoning_effort is passed unchanged. any-llm 1.33.0 sends thinking disabled for none or omitted effort; Sonnet 5.5 rejects that on the real API. Replay preserves this library request behavior; these cells grade response handling.

extra.anthropic.cache uses the native cache_control keyword. eager_input_streaming uses the SDK extra_body tools field because any-llm's generic tool conversion drops per-tool native options; only the scenario-requested flag is added.
The forced-tool structured-output scenario is unsupported: response_format selects native JSON output and ordinary tool calls do not attempt structured parsing.
